body_patterns: Reuse v1 unchanged; only context source binding is revised

state_contract.storage: Lab-only singleton table; source IDs/cursor/revision/version/frame, no raw copies
state_contract.source_access: Only current revision, validated root and <=64 pending user sources; never replay models/actions
state_contract.invalid: Unverified frame and explicitly deferred bounded rewrite, no invented ordinary authority
state_contract.end: Explicit writing end/reality transition revoke old creative exemption

prospective_policy: Known C15 failures become regression only. Freeze implementation+CPU+new protocol before any new real-model call; no tuning on same prospective outputs. Separate native/corrected/uncertain and all source profiles.
